blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Will it be fair to let senators who did not follow Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial vote as the Senate court makes its ruling on the case? Rep. Bienvenido “Benny” Abante Jr., chair of the House Committee on Human Rights, raised that question during an online media conference on Friday as the Senate impeachment court had started reviewing whether conviction must always require 16 votes or whether the number could change when some senators could not participate. For Abante, a sponsor of the fourth impeachment complaint against Duterte, the question is not merely whether a senator remains […]...
